refreshSeconds.description: Refresh interval in seconds; replaces `refreshHours` (the manager sets it from the global Mihomo settings).

urlRef.description: Subscription URL secret (URLs usually embed a token).

configName.description: File name (without `.yaml`) of the managed configuration under /etc/openclash/config/.

dnsIntegration.description: Probe the DNS listener OpenClash provides (`dns_port`) so a dnsmasq front end can use it as backend.

downloadProxy.description: Proxy used to fetch subscriptions (must not depend on OpenClash itself being up).

enabled.description: Disabling hands OpenClash back: recorded options are restored and managed files removed.

mode.description: OpenClash running mode (`en_mode`); unset keeps the user's current choice.

restartOnChange.description: Restart OpenClash automatically when the managed config or options change (otherwise use the action).

select.description: Make the managed configuration OpenClash's active `config_path`.
